tasks.instruction: The blue tiger kneels beside a low wooden bench, pressing both open palms flat on its surface as if smoothing a cloth while looking over one shoulder toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: three-quarter low angle, bench fills lower frame, palms clearly lit
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully visible on the bench top, fingers spread and unobstructed.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在长凳旁双手按桌面回头看

tasks.instruction: Standing on tiptoe, the tiger stretches one arm high to hang a round paper lantern on a hook, the other open hand splayed against the wall for balance, seen from a low side angle.
tasks.camera: low side angle, lantern and wall hook in upper frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clear: raised hand and wall-bracing palm visible with all fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚挂灯笼一手扶墙

tasks.instruction: Seated cross-legged on a woven mat, the tiger holds a large ceramic bowl in its lap with both open palms cradling the base, leaning forward to inspect the contents.
tasks.camera: front high angle looking down at the bowl and lap
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms visible under the bowl rim, fingers wrapping the curve without hiding digits.
tasks.intent_zh: 盘腿抱着大碗低头看

tasks.instruction: The tiger crouches behind a tall stack of books, peeking over the top while one open palm presses flat on the uppermost cover, the other hand gripping the shelf edge.
tasks.camera: eye-level from front, books occupy foreground lower third
tasks.visibility_requirement: Top open palm fully visible on the book cover; gripping hand allowed partial, count only the palm.
tasks.intent_zh: 躲在书堆后一只手压书顶

tasks.instruction: Balancing a broom upright on one open palm, the tiger looks up at the handle tip, the other arm extended sideways, standing in a wide stance on a tiled floor.
tasks.camera: medium wide shot, slight low angle, full body and broom head visible
tasks.visibility_requirement: The balancing palm and all five fingers are unobstructed against the broom handle.
tasks.intent_zh: 手掌立扫帚平衡

tasks.instruction: Lying on its side under a low table, the tiger reaches one open hand up to touch the tabletop underside while the other palm rests on the floor, head turned toward camera.
tasks.camera: ground-level side view beneath a glass-topped table
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms visible, the upward hand flat against table underside, floor palm unobscured.
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺桌下伸手触摸桌面底部

tasks.instruction: The tiger stands at a chalkboard, one open palm pressed flat against the board while the other hand holds a chalk stick, body angled so the pressing palm faces the viewer.
tasks.camera: over-the-shoulder three-quarter view showing board and open palm
tasks.visibility_requirement: The flat palm on the board is fully visible with spread fingers; chalk hand may be partial.
tasks.intent_zh: 一手按黑板一手拿粉笔

tasks.instruction: Crouching low, the tiger rolls a large wooden hoop forward with one open palm flat on its rim, the other hand lifted behind for balance, tail curled upward.
tasks.camera: side tracking view, hoop in foreground, motion suggested by posture
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pushing palm fully visible on hoop rim; lifted hand visible with fingers separated.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲着推木环滚动

tasks.instruction: The tiger leans over a stone well, one open palm cupped near its ear to listen, the other hand resting flat on the well's rim, face turned down into the opening.
tasks.camera: high three-quarter shot from behind and above the well
tasks.visibility_requirement: Cupped ear hand and rim palm both visible with digits distinguishable.
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在井边侧耳倾听

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a swing seat, the tiger pushes off the ground with one open palm flat against the dirt, the other hand holding the rope, body tilted mid-motion.
tasks.camera: low side angle, swing rope diagonal across frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Ground-pushing palm fully visible with all fingers touching dirt; rope hand may be partial.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在秋千上手撑地起步

tasks.instruction: The tiger crouches at a puddle, one open palm hovering just above the water surface as if testing temperature, the other arm braced on its knee, reflection visible below.
tasks.camera: low front angle, puddle and reflection in lower frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Hovering palm fully visible above water with spread digits; braced arm hand visible on knee.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在水坑边伸手试水温

tasks.instruction: The tiger stands before a tall door, pressing one open palm flat on the wood while the other hand shields its eyes, peering through a keyhole.
tasks.camera: side-front angle, door plane fills right side
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flat palm on door clearly visible; shielding hand visible with fingers spread near brow.
tasks.intent_zh: 一手按门一手遮眼看锁孔

tasks.instruction: Kneeling on a cushion, the tiger fans a small fire with a woven mat held in one open hand, the other palm flat on the floor for support, smoke curling upward.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter angle, embers glowing in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: Fanning palm gripping the mat visible with wrist and fingers; floor palm fully visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪坐用草席扇火

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a large floor pillow, the tiger holds a book open above its face with both hands, elbows resting on the cushion, eyes scanning the pages.
tasks.camera: top-down overhead shot of the tiger and open book
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands visible holding the book edges, fingers clear against the pages.
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺举书阅读

tasks.instruction: The tiger squats beside a potted plant, one open palm cupping a leaf while the other hand presses a small trowel into the soil, looking closely at the stem.
tasks.camera: close three-quarter low angle, plant leaves framing the face
tasks.visibility_requirement: Leaf-cupping palm fully visible with fingers around the leaf; trowel hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在花盆旁托叶检查

tasks.instruction: Standing in a kitchen, the tiger cracks an egg into a bowl with one hand, the other open palm flat on the counter, head tilted to watch the shell.
tasks.camera: medium close-up over the counter, hands and bowl central
tasks.visibility_requirement: Counter palm fully visible flat with spread digits; cracking hand visible at bowl rim.
tasks.intent_zh: 厨房单手打蛋一手扶台面

tasks.instruction: The tiger climbs a short ladder, one open palm flat on a rung while the other reaches for the next, body angled and one knee bent high.
tasks.camera: low side angle looking up the ladder
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms visible on rungs with fingers wrapping clearly.
tasks.intent_zh: 爬梯子双手抓横档

tasks.instruction: The tiger kneels to slide a flat plate under a low cabinet, one open palm pushing the plate's edge, the other hand steadying the cabinet door.
tasks.camera: low floor-level side view, plate and palm near the gap
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pushing palm flat on plate edge fully visible; door steadying hand visible with fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪着把盘子推入柜底

tasks.instruction: The tiger reaches up to a clothesline, one open palm pinning a towel to the line while the other hand holds a clothespin, standing on a small stool.
tasks.camera: side view with clothesline crossing upper frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Towel-pressing palm fully visible on the line with fingers flat; pin hand visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在凳上晾毛巾按衣夹

tasks.instruction: Sitting at a low table, the tiger spreads a large map flat with both open palms, leaning over it as if tracing a route with its eyes.
tasks.camera: high front angle looking down on the table and map
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on the map, all fingers spread and clearly visible.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐桌前双手摊开地图

tasks.instruction: The tiger stands pressed against a wall, palms flat on the surface, peeking around the corner toward the viewer, one foot lifted mid-step.
tasks.camera: corner-level front view, wall edge splitting the frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flat on the wall with all fingers visible, none occluded by the corner.
tasks.intent_zh: 贴墙探头偷看

tasks.instruction: The tiger balances on one leg while pressing an open palm against a tall stack of cushions to keep it from toppling, the other arm out for balance.
tasks.camera: medium wide shot, cushion stack and raised leg in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pressing palm fully visible against cushion side; balance arm hand visible with spread fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 单腿站立扶住歪倒的靠垫

tasks.instruction: Crouching under a hanging sheet, the tiger holds a flashlight in one hand and presses the other open palm against the fabric, casting a shadow puppet.
tasks.camera: side view inside the sheet tent, shadow shapes on fabric
tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm pressing fabric clearly visible with digits; flashlight hand visible in silhouette.
tasks.intent_zh: 钻在床单里手掌按布演影子戏

tasks.instruction: The tiger leans out a window, one open palm flat on the sill, the other hand tossing seeds to birds below, feathers and motion in the air.
tasks.camera: front three-quarter, window frame around the tiger
tasks.visibility_requirement: Sill palm fully visible flat; tossing hand visible with fingers extended in mid-throw.
tasks.intent_zh: 倚窗一手扶台一手撒种子

tasks.instruction: Kneeling at a bathtub, the tiger swirls one open hand in the water while the other palm rests flat on the tub rim, sleeves pushed up.
tasks.camera: high three-quarter angle looking into the tub
tasks.visibility_requirement: Swirling hand visible above water with fingers; rim palm fully visible flat on porcelain.
tasks.intent_zh: 跪在浴缸边搅水和扶边

tasks.instruction: The tiger pushes a wheelbarrow up a slope, both open palms flat on the handles, leaning its weight forward, a garden in the background.
tasks.camera: side low angle emphasizing the incline and grip
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms on handles with yellow palm pads visible; fingers not fully hidden by the grips.
tasks.intent_zh: 推独轮车上坡双手握把

tasks.instruction: Sitting on a doorstep, the tiger polishes a boot with a cloth held in one hand, the other open palm pressed flat on the doorstep for balance.
tasks.camera: low front angle, boot and hands in foreground
tasks.visibility_requirement: Polishing hand and step-bracing palm both visible, fingers distinguishable.
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在门口台阶上擦靴子

tasks.instruction: The tiger crouches to open a low drawer, one open palm pulling the handle while the other palm presses the drawer face flat, face close to the gap.
tasks.camera: low side-front angle, drawer partially open
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pulling hand visible on handle; pressing palm flat on drawer face fully visible with fingers.
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲下拉抽屉一手按柜面

tasks.instruction: The tiger stands in tall grass holding a large kite string reel with one hand, the other open palm raised flat to test the wind, eyes toward the sky.
tasks.camera: low angle against a bright sky, grass blades framing the legs
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised wind-testing palm fully visible with spread fingers; reel hand visible holding the frame.
tasks.intent_zh: 站在草丛中举手试风向放风筝

tasks.instruction: The tiger squeezes behind a crowded armchair, one open palm flat against the chair back for support, the other hand lifting a fallen pillow from the seat.
tasks.camera: high three-quarter view over the chair back
tasks.visibility_requirement: Chair-back palm fully visible flat with fingers; pillow-lifting hand visible above the seat.
tasks.intent_zh: 从椅背后挤过去扶椅背捡枕头
